repair.fix: Validate an applied, causally closed cut and complete text-mark boundaries, export only its original operations and import them into a fresh private arena. Preserve original IDs/atoms without live checkout, schema relaxation or accepting a current reused ID.

contracts: verify_document_suggestion_effect_guarded returns Pending or an opaque VerifiedDocumentSuggestionEffect. A retained digest alone is not a semantic effect or history-ownership proof.

Re-execution uses the actual pre-effect causal basis and original effect writer. The original proposal source must precede that basis; original read dependencies must still match there. Both V2 digests, the exact end and the re-derived semantic start must reproduce the retained operations.
Permanent preparation is excluded from the verified semantic range. No supplied semanticFrom, AST snapshot or replacement operation batch is trusted as an inverse boundary.

The proof is pure, including in read-only mode. It changes no live roots, content, UI, counters, stacks or publication. Frozen metadata remains readable while exact owner/publication guards refuse stale or foreign use.

Authenticated finality, current account authority, original accepting-device identity, server durability and local history adoption remain separate host/coordinator contracts. No browser effect executor or arbitrary inverse API is added.

Operation-only historical reads retain original causal atoms, clock ends and immutable document binding while excluding future arena-only handles. Current native freshness, schema, source-cut and resource laws remain intact.

Native effect metadata gains closed deserialization without changing its existing serialized shape or any saved family. Existing defaults, journal meanings, operation/frame protocols and application export surfaces remain unchanged.

The documented next history contract requires one ordered native stack, explicit opt-in recovery, existing ordinary Undo/Redo preservation, durable idempotent owned adoption, natural typing fences, cursor-basis repair and source-before-dependent-receipt persistence. No replicated marker roots or writer counter reservations are introduced by this checkpoint.
